subject: Helios Cloud MSA — insurance redline and COI delivery logistics
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: contracts@helioscloud.com
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Helios Cloud MSA — insurance redline and COI delivery logistics

Hi team,

Thanks for sending the latest MSA / Order Form. I've attached our consolidated redline (Helios_MSARedline_v3.pdf) with a few outstanding insurance items that need confirmation before we can countersign:

1) Coverage minimums — our standard asks are reflected in the redline: 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate CGL, 5M umbrella. I flagged Helios' proposed limits in the doc; please confirm if your broker can meet these or, if not, propose the absolute maximum the carrier will commit to.

2) Additional Insured endorsement — we need Helios (and their subcontractors) to add "Redwood Inference, its subsidiaries and affiliates" as additional insured on the CGL and provide the endorsement wording.

3) Primary & non-contributory — please confirm the carrier will provide a primary/non-contributory endorsement.

4) COI delivery — we prefer the broker upload the COI/endorsement to DocuSign or our secure SFTP prior to countersignature. If that is not possible, email delivery to contracts@redwood.com is acceptable.

Can you ask the broker for: carrier name, policy numbers, limits, effective/expiry dates, and a timeline for COI + endorsement delivery? We typically need COI and endorsement confirmation before finalizing the Order Form.

Target timeline on our side: get COI/endorsement within 3 business days so Legal can complete the final review. If Helios needs an exception (e.g., lower umbrella), please detail the gap and whether they can add Redwood as additional insured.

Attaching: OrderForm_Helios_v2.pdf (reference), Helios_MSARedline_v3.pdf.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachment: Helios_MSARedline_v3.pdf (redline)

From: contracts@helioscloud.com
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: broker@atlasinsurance.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Helios Cloud MSA — insurance redline and COI delivery logistics

Mina — thanks for the note and the consolidated redline.

We looped in our broker (broker@atlasinsurance.com) to confirm. Quick answers up front:
- Carrier: Atlas Mutual (will provide policy declarations).
- CGL: carrier responsive but can only commit to 3M aggregate at this time (they do not offer the 5M umbrella our CFO prefers).
- Additional insured: broker confirms they can add Redwood as additional insured; endorsement may follow slightly after the COI (standard broker practice).
- Primary/non-contributory: carrier is willing to provide primary & non-contributory language, subject to final underwriting sign-off.

Attached is a sample COI request bundle the broker asked us to use (COI-Sample-Request.pdf).

Alternative proposal from Helios: accept 3M CGL + 2M umbrella (total combined 5M exposure), with Redwood named as additional insured and a primary/non-contrib endorsement. If Redwood Legal is ok with combined limits that way, we can move quickly.

DocuSign: we've uploaded the order form for signature (link below) — broker prefers to issue COI once countersignature is in place. If Redwood requires COI before signature, let us know and we'll ask the broker to prioritize pre-sign COI issuance.

Thanks,
Sam Nguyen
Contracts Lead, Helios Cloud
contracts@helioscloud.com

Subject: Re: Helios Cloud MSA — insurance redline and COI delivery logistics

Olga / Karthik — Helios is proposing the following insurance path: 3M CGL + 2M umbrella (carrier: Atlas Mutual), Redwood to be named additional insured, and primary/non-contrib endorsement to be issued. They uploaded a COI sample bundle.

Can Legal confirm whether we can accept 3M + 2M umbrella instead of our standard 1M/2M/5M split? My read: the key mitigant is having the additional insured endorsement + primary/non-contrib. If we accept the combined 5M exposure via umbrella and get the endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, its subsidiaries and affiliates," I think risk is reasonably mitigated — but want Legal sign-off on:

- Acceptable endorsement form (we prefer ISO CG 20 10-style language or equivalent).
- Whether we require any specific waiver of subrogation language.
- Whether COI must be provided prior to countersignature or if post-signature upload is acceptable in this case.

As next steps: please review the attached Helios_MSARedline_v3.pdf and confirm (a) accept 3M+2M umbrella? (b) endorsement language acceptable? (c) timeline — broker says they can issue COI within 48 hours of confirmation.

If Legal is ok, I will instruct Helios/broker to upload COI to DocuSign (link below) and proceed with countersignature.

Thanks,
Mina

Attachment: Helios_MSARedline_v3.pdf

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@helioscloud.com, broker@atlasinsurance.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helios Cloud MSA — insurance redline and COI delivery logistics

Team / Helios — I reviewed the proposed plan and am comfortable with the 3M CGL + 2M umbrella alternative provided the following are confirmed in writing and appended to the Order Form prior to completion:

1) Endorsement wording: Helios' carrier will issue an additional insured endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, its subsidiaries and affiliates". Endorsement must be on the carrier's endorsement form (or ISO equivalent).

2) Primary/non-contributory: carrier will issue a primary & non-contributory endorsement with language that applies to claims made by Redwood as additional insured.

3) Waiver of subrogation: acceptable if the waiver is issued where allowed by law and the policy includes the waiver on the CGL. If the carrier cannot waive subrogation, the broker must note it explicitly.

4) COI delivery: broker should upload COI + endorsement PDF to our DocuSign session or to secure SFTP and email contracts@redwood.com with confirmation. We require the COI and endorsement be visible to Legal before final countersignature; if Helios needs countersignature to get COI, we can accept a conditional countersign but prefer the COI prior.

5) Reference the HubSpot deal id (HCL-2027-0921) on the COI note field to help matching.

If the broker can confirm (1)-(4) and upload the docs within 48 hours, Legal will approve this insurance package and we can finish signatures. Broker / Helios — please confirm timeline and upload method.

Thanks — Olga Petrov
Counsel, Contracts & Procurement, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
